LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FIVE.titleEnglish: Give an Approximate Amount with 多
LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FIVE.learnerPromise: Say “over ten,” “over one hundred,” or “a little after twelve” without claiming an exact number.
LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FIVE.explanation: After a round number, 多 means somewhere above it: 一百多 is 101–199. After a unit, it means slightly beyond: 十一點多 is a little after eleven.

teachingGlossary.meaning: two before 百, 千, or a measure word

teachingGlossary.traditional: 零九三六零六八四九三
teachingGlossary.pinyin: líng jiǔ sān liù, líng liù bā, sì jiǔ sān
liǎng qiān liǎng bǎi wèi lǎoshī

teachingGlossary.meaning: older than four but not yet five
a little more than ten cakes

LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FIVE.pattern: Round number + 多 + measure word, or number + measure word + 多

discoveryLab.title: Move 多, change the size of the fuzzy zone
discoveryLab.description: 多 always means “over,” but its position tells the listener how wide the possible range is.
discoveryLab.prompt: How wide is the unknown extra amount?

choices.label: After a round ten
choices.note: 多 follows 十, so the unknown part can fill the ones place.

choices.label: After a round hundred
choices.note: 多 follows 百, so the amount stays below the next hundred.

choices.label: After the measure word
choices.english: a little more than ten cakes
choices.note: 多 follows 個, so the extra amount is less than one whole 個.

choices.label: A little after a time
choices.note: 多 follows 點, so the time is after eleven but before twelve.

discoveryLab.takeaway: 多 after a round number gives a wider range; 多 after a unit means only a little beyond it.

items.question: There are fifteen cakes. Where does 多 go?
items.answer: After the round number 十: 十多個. 十個多 would mean just a little more than ten.

items.question: The clock shows a little after twelve. 多 before or after 點?
items.answer: After 點: 十二點多. For a clock hour, 多 follows the time unit.

items.question: A child is older than four but not yet five. How do I say it?
items.answer: 四歲多 — 多 goes after 歲, so the extra is less than one full year.

right.english: Older than four but not yet five.

words.meaning: older than four but not yet five

text.english: More than two weeks but less than three.

LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FOUR.lessonTitleEnglish: Would You Like Coffee or Tea?
LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FOUR.titleEnglish: Build Large Numbers by Place Value
LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FOUR.learnerPromise: Read prices, quantities, and large numbers without guessing.
LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FOUR.explanation: Chinese names each place: 十, 百, 千, then 萬 for ten thousand. Read from large to small, and use 零 once to bridge a skipped place.

teachingGlossary.meaning: two before 百, 千, or a measure word

teachingGlossary.traditional: 零九三六零六八四九三
teachingGlossary.pinyin: líng jiǔ sān liù, líng liù bā, sì jiǔ sān
liǎng qiān liǎng bǎi wèi lǎoshī

teachingGlossary.meaning: older than four but not yet five
a little more than ten cakes

LESSON_FOUR_GRAMMAR_FOUR.pattern: Large place + smaller places, with 零 for an internal gap

numberLab.title: Climb the place-value staircase
numberLab.description: Tap a number. Each block shows which place contributes sound and where 零 bridges an empty step.
numberLab.prompt: Choose a number to take apart

choices.note: The tens place is empty between two spoken places, so 零 bridges 百 to 五.
Two empty places are crossed with one 零, not two.
零 bridges the missing 千 place. Zeroes at the end are not spoken.
Chinese groups large numbers around 萬: 305 groups of ten thousand.

numberLab.takeaway: Read large to small; use one 零 for an empty place inside; do not say zeroes at the end.

items.question: 5,080 — do I say 零?
items.answer: Yes, once. One 零 bridges the empty 百 place: 五千零八十.

items.question: 2,200 — is it 二 or 兩?
items.answer: 兩. Use 兩 before 千, 百, and 萬: 兩千兩百. 二 stays in tens and single digits.

right.pinyin: Liǎng qiān liǎng bǎi wèi lǎoshī.

words.pinyin: liǎng qiān liǎng bǎi wèi lǎoshī

items.question: How do I say 30,000?
items.answer: 三萬. After 千 comes 萬, the ten-thousand group: 三萬, not 三十千.

examples.teachingNote: Every place from 百 through 個 has a value, so no 零 is needed.
One 零 bridges both missing middle places.

questions.correctFeedback: 零 bridges 千 to 十 because the 百 place is empty.
questions.repairFeedback: Use one 零 for the internal gap: 五千零八十.

segments.answer: 零九三六零六八四九三
segments.hint: Phone numbers read digit by digit.

tiles.traditional: 零九三六零六八四九三
tiles.pinyin: líng jiǔ sān liù, líng liù bā, sì jiǔ sān

tiles.traditional: 九百三十六萬零六百八十四
tiles.pinyin: jiǔ bǎi sānshíliù wàn líng liù bǎi bāshísì
jiǔ sān liù liù bā sì jiǔ sān

questions.correctFeedback: Phone numbers are read one digit at a time, so say each digit, including 零.
questions.repairFeedback: Do not read a phone number as one big number. Read each digit.

tiles.pinyin: liǎng qiān liǎng bǎi wèi lǎoshī
liǎng qiān líng liǎng bǎi wèi lǎoshī

questions.correctFeedback: Nothing is skipped between 千 and 百; 位 is the polite measure word for people.
questions.repairFeedback: Read 兩千兩百 without 零, then add 位老師.

dialogue.title: 對話二 · Dialogue 2
dialogue.setting: 在餐廳櫃台點餐 · Ordering at the restaurant counter

text.traditional: 小姐，我們要點兩碗牛肉麵和兩杯茶。
text.simplified: 小姐，我们要点两碗牛肉面和两杯茶。
text.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒmen yào diǎn liǎng wǎn niúròu miàn hé liǎng bēi chá.
text.english: Miss, we would like to order two bowls of beef noodles and two cups of tea.

text.traditional: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
text.simplified: 请问两位要红茶还是绿茶？
text.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
text.english: Would you two like black tea or green tea?

text.traditional: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
text.simplified: 请给我们一杯红茶、一杯绿茶。请问一共多少钱？
text.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
text.english: Please give us one black tea and one green tea. How much is it altogether?

text.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi yīshíwǔ kuài qián.

words.meaning: two before 百, 千, or a measure word

text.traditional: 找您七百八十五塊錢，謝謝。
text.simplified: 找您七百八十五块钱，谢谢。
text.pinyin: Zhǎo nín qī bǎi bāshíwǔ kuài qián, xièxie.
text.english: Here is 785 dollars in change. Thank you.

text.traditional: 一共兩百多塊錢，好便宜！
text.simplified: 一共两百多块钱，好便宜！
text.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi duō kuài qián, hǎo piányi!
text.english: It is a little over 200 dollars in total. So inexpensive!
